owner_direction: prioritise restricted-domain Python-only preparation; no approved numerical loss values, tolerances, cap, freeze or execution

scope.study: single fixed physically derived computational response population, conditional numerical reliability only
scope.candidate_revision: owner-selected immutable 19 November archived capture; original and unique derivative SHA/size verified in attributed local receipt
scope.uncalibrated_case_route: requires independent applicability decision; no engineering or physical calibration claim
scope.native: excluded; zero allocation and #150 stop unchanged

sources.archived_ifd: authenticated matched candidate export per B; 24h six anchors
sources.archived_tp: authenticated areal file and metadata per B; 10 source IDs at 24h, area category common to both sites per A
sources.areal_tp_weights_proposed: one explicit full-domain conditional pool of ten eligible members at 0.1 each; independent approval required
sources.loss_basis: NaN archived Data Hub values are not evidence; do not re-label archived deterministic IL/CL; source-backed regional/transfer or actual adopted storm-loss record, or expressly separate numerical scenario if approved
sources.loss_factor_table: candidate corrected empirical factors, source/erratum/endpoint and applicability review pending
sources.dependence: explicitly proposed independent empirical loss conditional on rainfall and eligible TP; not approved
sources.preburst_proposal: none/PB=0 as conditional numerical assumption only; no subtraction/clamp or climate change default without decision
sources.arf: applicable pinned ARR2019 region/area formula once, no extensions; review #192

probability.conditional_cdf_denominator: fixed 0.49 of planned rainfall-coordinate mass; all failed/unstarted weights retained
probability.target_preflight_field: legacy target_flood_aep_fractions interpreted only as conditional response targets in research sidecar
probability.production_full_domain_quantiles: incomplete; no production renormalisation or frequency change

estimands.primary: latent numerical whole-1000-run reliability for frozen conditional population and margin rule; conditional on independent screening result
estimands.secondary: operational complete result counts/status and observed run spread, not latent reliability or mean uncertainty
components: six conditional peak quantiles at 2 sites x 3 targets
conditional CDF at three pilot-frozen median thresholds per site, exact deduplication
estimands.margin_abs_basis_proposed: positive site-specific numerical reporting floor based on explicitly reviewed archived reporting unit or independent numerical decision; no engineering tolerance inferred

design.stratification: existing v1 equal normal-coordinate widths, unequal exact probability masses; reverse to ascending p and persist canonical edges/weights
design.root_rule: independent uniform uint64 roots with replacement preassigned to all planned cohorts; any duplicate/identity overlap abort unresolved, do not condition inference on collision-free selection or redraw; HMAC purpose/domain separation plus computational independence assumption
phase_order: independent coverage/implementation review; separately authorised synthetic qualification
pre-screen freeze and separately authorised intake/screen
freeze derived scales/grid and verify precision feasibility
design.larger_screens: 5k/10k screens, alternative budget confirmation, extra duration and native/replay excluded; separately approved new protocol only
design.stop: pre-launch worst-case cohort incl cleanup fits remaining caps, actual complete planned allocations and identity verified; stop on budget, law/identity or unsupported state; keep all preassigned unstarted/aborted slots unknown; no outcome-dependent replacement or optional CI stopping

inference.reference_grid: per site 0 + pooled complete independent 30-screen conditional step quantiles at 0.01..1.00 nonexceedance + max(0,m_j+k*Delta_j) for k=-2,-1,-0.5,-0.25,0,0.25,0.5,1,2 for three target medians; dedup; max 128/site, K<=256 latent CDF points
inference.reference_rule: latent independent complete planned indicators I(Q<=x); weighted range v_h/n_h, v_h=w_h/0.49; Hoeffding epsilon=sqrt(sum(v_h^2/n_h)*log(2*K/alpha_reference)/2); enclose latent weighted empirical CDF by pointwise observed interval sums, unknown [0,+inf]; do not require independent observed censoring; monotone tighten, conservatively invert with U(x)<t for lower and L(x)>=t for upper; no extrapolation
inference.latent_law_requirement: total defined nonnegative Q per site and preassigned independent draws under frozen implemented midpoint law; genuine undefined response or unverifiable law -> unresolved, not imputed
inference.single_run: latent empirical complete output vector; definite pass if all admissible vector/reference pairs meet every margin; definite fail if no admissible pair meets them; otherwise unknown; include unstarted/aborted cohorts
inference.reliability_rule: on simultaneous reference coverage, D <= latent iid successful cohort count <= P; CP monotone lower(D,n) upper(P,n), n=300 planned; adequacy lower>=.95, inadequacy upper<.95, else unresolved; do not apply iid CP directly to observed classifications; condition on independent frozen screen, not cap or selection
inference.no_scope_expansion: no native equivalence or annual flood inference; no extra inferential sensitivity claims

synthetic_qualification.coverage_metrics: up to six predeclared metrics/control; two one-sided exact intervals allocated .05/(2*8*6); deterministic enclosure invariants must hold; uncertainty on empirical coverage, false decisions and power, no proof of nominal coverage

gates.candidate_scope: archived revision adopted as candidate only; review A/B source evidence and rights/calibration limitation
gates.policy: source-supported loss values and factor table, TP weights, dependence, baseline/ARF/preburst/area/clock; no fabricated source
gates.analytic: independent amended latent-law/design review and separately approved coverage/power qualification
gates.manifests: actual source, weights, roots, reference, confirmation, confidence and synthetic validation manifests reviewed; no generator now
gates.owner: review proposed numerical margins/absolute floors, power objectives, 300 confirmations and resource limits, separately approve each execution stage
gates.preflight: existing checker on local admitted declaration only; previous exit 1 unchanged; five lanes distinct; no execution approval even if external review required
